title: Hook commands need sh, so the raw-read hint cannot fire under PowerShell without Git Bash
goal: The PowerShell-side PreToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json starts without sh (a hook entry with shell powershell that runs kb_hook.py through a Python launcher), so a Windows host without Git Bash gets the raw-read hint; the other hooks that start through sh are checked for the same dependency

run: import json,sys; h=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json',encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']['PreToolUse']; sys.exit(0 if any('PowerShell' in e.get('matcher','') and any(x.get('shell')=='powershell' and not x.get('command','').startswith('sh ') for x in e['hooks']) for e in h) else 1)
